subject: computer-science
title: Digital Wellbeing: Online Behaviour
welcome_lead: Treat others online how you'd treat them face to face.
meta_desc: KS3 e-safety: cyberbullying, kindness, reporting, friends online.
final_note: Most people online want a good time — be one of them.

concepts.def: Using tech to upset or harm someone.
Telling a platform or adult about harm.
Treating others as you'd want to be treated.

walkthroughs.body_html: Mean comments, exclusion or rumours online are cyberbullying. Save the evidence with a screenshot and tell a trusted adult.
Saying nothing helps bullies. Safely speak up: a kind comment, a private message to the target, or a report to the app.
Every major app has block and report buttons. Use them. They are private and quick.

mcqs.q: First thing to do about cyberbullying?
options: Save evidence and tell an adult

numericals.q: How many sides has cyberbullying (bully, target, bystander)?
